analogy.rationale: Integrin antagonists target ITGA2B/ITGB3 (platelet fibrinogen receptor), which is essentially absent from these adherent non-hematopoietic cell lines, so little transcriptional response is expected; the closest listed classes are other anti-adhesion/anti-angiogenic or platelet-related mechanisms that also act on poorly expressed targets in these cells.
